name: Plugsera Live SERP Preview
author: plugsera

sections.description:
Plugsera Live SERP Preview helps you see a real-time preview of how your post, page, or product may appear in Google search results while editing content.

The plugin is designed to be lightweight and easy to use, focusing only on SERP preview without complex configuration or external dependencies.

Preview appearance may vary based on how search engines display results.

Features

  • Live Google-style SERP preview inside the editor
  • Works with posts, pages, and WooCommerce products
  • Clean and lightweight interface
  • No external APIs
  • No tracking or data collection

Pro Version

Plugsera Live SERP Preview Pro is a separate plugin that unlocks advanced SEO assistance, including:
* Snippet optimization score
* SEO publish readiness status
* SERP preview history and comparison
* Actionable SEO suggestions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Edit any post, page, or product to view the SERP preview below the title field
